openings.claim: Preserve the opposed pressure-distribution and geometry predictions; evaluate balanced removable clamps only if attachment feasibility resolves. No method winner is selected.
openings.delta: Change concentrated left-corner loading to balanced placement using four strips, four bolts, four pads and tethered assemblies. Nearest rival: hatch/seal geometry dominates pressure placement. Opposed lateral stops remain an untested alternative.
openings.prediction: Distribution predicts reduced opposite-corner lift with controlled sliding after balancing; geometry dominance predicts persistent or relocated lift. Tighter retention may control sliding while worsening lift or reopening, so coupled measurements decide acceptance. Equal bolt turns do not establish equal forces.
openings.probe: Check accessible rim geometry, strip span, safe padded contacts, recoverable tethers and unobstructed removal before fabrication. If feasible within ninety minutes, screen left-biased placement with one ordinary and one right-card-disturbed closure/pull; then perform ten balanced opening/closure/pull cycles, disturbing the final closure. Record marked displacement, corner heights, 20 N retention, reopening time, visible seal condition and maintenance using supplied tools. Twelve trials exhaust capacity; screening cannot validate the rival. If twenty-minute recording capacity or safe geometry fails, report unresolved without outcome claims.
assumptions: Rim access, contact safety, strip stiffness and tether locations are unspecified.

Position beyond 1 mm, failed 20 N retention, reopening beyond 30 seconds, new seal tears, permanent deformation, lost components or blocked inspection defeat acceptance. Final disturbance waives only seal contact continuity.
